name: befall
stderr:
Usage: befall [options] [command]

CLI entrypoint for Befall agent coordination.

Options:
  -V, --version    output the version number
  -h, --help       display help for command

Commands:
  doctor           Check the local Befall CLI scaffold.
  login [options]  Approve this machine and store a Befall token for daemon/API
                   calls.
  init [options]   Initialize Befall room metadata in this git repository.
  up               Start the local daemon and print MCP setup snippets.
  mcp [options]    Run the stdio MCP server for Claude Code, Codex CLI, or
                   Cursor.
  status           Print local daemon, room, and git state.
  down             Stop the local daemon.
  help [command]   display help for command
